ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) with a white-to-black pixel ratio of approximately 0.04:0.96 across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity dark field across both lobes. Micro-scale high-intensity focal spots (mottling) are localized in the inferior-medial regions and sparsely scattered along the lower-right lobe margin.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression with a pixel angle of approximately 45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serration profile. Pixel-amplitude variations of 3-10 pixels are consistent across the continuous linear boundary, with more pronounced jagged peaks on the medial portion of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the trailing edges, transitioning into a steep upward sweep at the distal extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, textured clusters of white and tan pixels located at the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Subtle, unaligned vertical linear disruptions (pale grey against dark field) visible on the right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Major physical protrusions at both fluke tips consisting of dense, irregular calcified clusters.
